_comment: THE PLANNER CONTRACT — reads the inbound call brief, breaks it into stages, writes a plan. Does nothing else.
_trust_tier_note: Tier 3 = WRITE INTERNAL. Can read files and write to Supabase. Cannot touch calendar, SMS, or external services.
one_job: Read the inbound call brief. Break the call into stages. Write a plan to state/artifacts/. Do not execute anything.

inputs.transcript_so_far: string — raw transcript from Vapi webhook
inputs.advisor_id: string — which business account this belongs to

plan_file._comment: missing_fields must be an array. Empty array means all 5 fields collected. Any field name in the array means that field still needs to be collected.

completion_condition.description: The plan file exists at the correct path, contains all required fields, missing_fields is a valid array, and next_agent is one of: quote-agent, re-ask, escalate-to-human.
completion_condition.verifiable_check: file exists at state/artifacts/{call_sid}-plan.json AND JSON parses without error AND missing_fields is array AND next_agent is valid enum value

budget.on_breach: halt_and_log — write to state/traces/, surface to dashboard, do not retry automatically

the_five_fields._comment: The planner checks whether all 5 fields exist in the transcript. If any are missing they go into missing_fields array.
the_five_fields.name: caller full name

next_agent_rules.1_to_4_fields_missing: next_agent = re-ask — list missing fields so voice agent knows what to ask
next_agent_rules.caller_distressed_or_safety_concern: next_agent = escalate-to-human — do not attempt quote generation

level_1_recoverable.trigger: plan file missing a required field
level_1_recoverable.action: broaden by one axis, retry once

level_2_unrecoverable.action: halt, log, surface to dashboard, wait for human

what_this_agent_never_does: Never modifies vision.md, AGENTS.md, or RUNTIME.md
Never proceeds if the output file path is wrong
Never marks missing_fields as empty if any of the 5 fields are absent

assumption_log.assumption: Claude Sonnet can reliably extract 5 structured fields from a voice transcript without a specialized extraction model
assumption_log.expiry_test: Run 100 real transcripts, measure field extraction accuracy. If below 95% — evaluate fine-tuning or a dedicated extraction step.
assumption_log.kill_threshold: If accuracy >= 98% on a cheaper model (Haiku) — downgrade model tier and reduce cost
